unit.why: A short first-person memorate, quoted from Zohar Hai, about the author receiving an overwhelming illumination from his master R. Zvi, with a brief closing teaching on the meaning of 'Rebbe'.

stories.start_quote: עוד שם פ"א בהיותי במדינת פולין
stories.summary_en: While in Poland, the narrator received from his master R. Zvi such a wondrous illumination and spiritual attainment that he could not bear it, and had to go back to him to ask him to take some of it away; the 'Rebbe' is so called because he receives from his master, back in a chain to Elijah.

tags.why: The whole anecdote is about the spiritual flow from master to disciple.

quotes: לזה יקרא רבי כי נסמך ולקח מרבו
tags.why: Doctrine of the rebbe as one who receives and transmits through a chain of masters.

quotes: והשפיע עלי כל כך הארה נפלאה והשגה
tags.why: The disciple receives a supernatural illumination and attainment.
He goes back to his master to have the illumination reduced.
Supernatural transfer of illumination from the master.

missing_concepts: excess of spiritual illumination that is unbearable and must be reduced
chain of transmission (semikhah) from master to disciple
